name: Memory
description: Persistent memory: vault entity pages plus curated USER.md / MEMORY.md / PROJECT.md.

function.name: memory
function.description:
Save durable facts to persistent memory (Markdown under $TOMO_HOME). Saved facts come back in future sessions, so keep them compact and high-signal.

WHEN — save proactively (do NOT wait for "remember this"):
- User states a preference, correction, or personal detail
- You learn a stable fact about a person, project, tool, place, org, or topic in their life/work
- You learn a stable fact about their environment, hostnames, conventions, or workflow

PICK THE TARGET — route each fact to exactly one:
- entity → the knowledge vault, one page per thing. DEFAULT for facts ABOUT something: a project, a tool/service, another person, a place, an org, a topic. Pass entity="<type>/<slug>" with type in person|project|tool|place|org|topic and a lowercase-hyphen slug (project/tomo, tool/aio-serv, person/budi-santoso, org/kompas-tv). One fact per call. Mention related things as [[type/slug]] inside the fact to link pages, e.g. "Deployed on [[tool/aio-serv]] behind Cloudflare."
- user → memories/USER.md — ONLY who the user themself is: name, role, preferences, communication style, corrections to how you work. Not their projects, servers, or other people — those are entities.
- memory → agents/<id>/MEMORY.md — your own working notes: tool quirks, lessons, conventions for how YOU operate.
- project → PROJECT.md of the current workplace — repo-local conventions and layout.
Examples: "User prefers Indonesian casual replies" → user. "Tomo is a FastAPI agent IDE; UI uses vanilla JS" → entity project/tomo. "aio-serv listens on 8000" → entity tool/aio-serv. "Budi is the user's DevOps lead" → entity person/budi. "web_fetch fails on kompas.tv without a UA header" → memory.

HOW: action=add|replace|remove|list. entity supports add|list only (list shows the page). For replace/remove on other targets, pass old= a short unique substring of the existing entry.

SKIP: trivial/obvious info, easily re-discovered facts, raw dumps, task progress, completed-work logs, temporary TODOs, PR/issue numbers, commit SHAs — use session_search for those. Reusable procedures belong in manage_skill.

STYLE: declarative facts, not self-instructions. "User prefers concise responses" ✓ — "Always respond concisely" ✗.

target.description: entity (vault page about a project/tool/person/place/org/topic — default for facts about things) | user (the user's own profile & preferences only) | memory (your agent notes) | project (workplace PROJECT.md) | all (list only)

content.description: Entry text for add (or new text for replace).

old.description: Unique substring identifying the entry for replace/remove.

agent_id.description: Defaults to the bound agent (for memory target).

workplace_id.description: Workplace id for project target (defaults from agent workplace).

entity.description: Required for target=entity: <type>/<slug>, type in person|project|tool|place|org|topic, e.g. project/tomo, tool/aio-serv.

source.description: Optional source day/session for the fact; defaults to today's date.
